title: The Laundry Room You'll Actually Want to Walk Into
description: The laundry room is the last space anyone renovates. Three cheap moves turn it from a dumping ground into the most functional square metre in the flat.
excerpt: A washing machine, a pile of laundry and a bare bulb overhead. The laundry room is the last room anyone fixes — and the fastest to pay off.
content:
The laundry room is where design gives up. A washing machine, clothes on the floor, detergent bottles on the windowsill, a bare bulb overhead. And yet it's a room you spend an hour a week in — at a fraction of what a kitchen costs to make decent.

## Vertical first, pretty second

Almost every laundry room has the same flaw: it uses the first metre off the floor and leaves the rest of the wall empty. The first move isn't paint, it's shelving. Two shelves above the machine and one hanging rail for dry clothes clears most of the chaos.

If your washer and dryer sit side by side, run a single continuous worktop across the top. That gives you a folding surface — the one change that genuinely shortens laundry time.

## Three cheap moves with outsized effect

**Light.** Swap the bare bulb for a diffused ceiling fitting around 4000 K. Neutral white is the only temperature where you can actually spot a stain on a white shirt.

**Closed storage bins.** Detergents in matching bins instead of fifteen loud packages. The visual noise disappears immediately and it costs almost nothing.

**Flooring.** Click-lock vinyl planks go down in an afternoon, handle water, and cover ugly concrete. Best effect-per-euro in the whole room.

## Look at it before you tear anything out

Small rooms are the hardest to plan — nobody can picture them properly in their head. Upload a photo of the space to [RoomFlip](https://roomflip.io) and generate a few versions: shelves on the left, tall cabinet on the right, a different wall colour. Within a minute you'll see whether that tall cabinet blocks the washer door.

When you move on to picking materials and collecting quotes, [FileTools](https://filetools.eu) is handy — merge supplier quotes and appliance manuals into one PDF and keep the whole project in a single file.

## The takeaway

A laundry room doesn't need a renovation, it needs a system. Shelves, light, bins, floor. One weekend of work and the room you used to avoid gets used differently — and none of it is a problem in a rental.
